description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Activated Parameters Ratio and Eval PPL for different models. The x-axis represents the Activated Parameters Ratio in percentage, with a linear scale, ranging from 100 to 25, and tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, with a linear scale, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot includes four lines: a red dashed line representing the Transformer model, which remains constant at approximately 11.5 across the x-axis; a grey solid line with square markers representing Only MoHD FFN, which starts at around 11.5 at 100% and decreases to approximately 11.8 at 25%; a dark blue solid line with circular markers representing Only MoHD ATTN, which starts at around 11.5 at 100% and increases to approximately 14.3 at 25%; and a blue solid line with cross markers representing MoHD ATTN + MLP, which starts at around 11.5 at 100% and increases to approximately 13.2 at 25%.
